speech_notes: Weary, pragmatic, dark Wasteland humor. Short clipped sentences. Trust earned slowly.

greeting: Another day above ground. That is something.
Do not get comfortable. Nothing out here stays quiet.
You look like you have been through it. Same.
You armed? Good. Everyone should be.
Back again. Did not think you would make it.
Morning. If you can call it that.
idle: Never thought I would miss traffic jams.
Caps are not worth what they used to be.
I keep patching this wall. Raiders keep knocking it down.
My back has been killing me. Brahmin feed bags do not carry themselves.
Found a working lighter today. Felt like winning the lottery.
We are running low on purified water again.
I used to have a job. An office. A commute. Now I have this.
Kid asked me what a mall was today.
Sleep well? Ha. Nobody sleeps well.
Got radroach in the crops again. Never ends.
Two hundred years and we are still arguing about water.
player_nearby: Help is always welcome if you are offering.
warning: Something is off. I can feel it.
Eyes open. I heard something on the east side.
That is too quiet. Quiet usually means something bad.
Get to cover. Do it now.
combat_start: We are under attack! Grab your weapons!
Do not let them breach the gate!
combat_taunt: I have got nothing left to lose - that makes me dangerous!
death: Tell my... tell them I tried.
At least... at least it is quiet now.
player_helps: Did not think you would come through. Glad I was wrong.
You have got good timing. I will say that.
We would have been done for without you.
Do not expect a parade. But thank you.
hardship: Some days the only thing keeping me going is spite.
The Wasteland does not care how hard you work. That is the lesson.
hope: This place is worth defending. That is more than most can say.
Maybe the kids will have it better. That is why we do this.
Still standing. That counts for something.
